en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a town at the base of a large mountain. The foreground shows dense mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks and industrial buildings, with curving roads and a rail or highway line. The background is dominated by a broad, rugged mountain labeled along the top edge of the card. The image has a white border with scalloped edges, typical of vintage postcards.
